decisions.reason: Because it remained on the website through 2024, fits tightly with the firm's core coolant-management offer, and the firm has enough capability and slack to back promising core extensions, its performance is likely at or above aspiration.

As a technically related extension of the established coolant portfolio that survived the first post-launch year, it likely met a satisfactory threshold even if adoption may still be somewhat niche and monitored.

The product supports the firm's broader conveying and production-support system business and, having stayed while some other 2023 launches disappeared, it likely looks acceptable relative to aspiration despite some portfolio rationalisation risk.

This conveyor variant remains consistent with the firm's modular automation portfolio and its continued listing suggests satisfactory early results, so management would more likely retain it than redeploy resources elsewhere.
